Rewards
Earn Skywards Miles on every eligible spend and enjoy a host of travel and lifestyle benefits.

Now you can make your credit card spending go even further. Just use your card to earn Skywards Miles you can redeem with Emirates and flydubai on flights, upgrades, partner airlines, hotels, gift cards and more. Plus, enjoy a host of exceptional travel and lifestyle benefits, offers and discounts.
Earning your Skywards Miles
• Get 10,000 sign-up bonus Skywards Miles when you pay your annual card fee
• Get another 15,000 Skywards Miles plus fast track to Silver Tier membership when you spend a minimum of ⃃Dirham20,000 in eligible spends in the first 60 days
Earn Skywards Miles
Get up to 1.75 Skywards Miles for every USD 1 equivalent in eligible spends on your card.
From year 2 onwards. Just spend at least AED 180,000 on eligible transactions over 12 months, including at least AED 10,000 directly with Emirates[@silvertierrenewal].
No Miles expiry
The Skyward Miles you earn with the card won't expire for as long as your Emirates Skywards account and credit card are open.[@nomilesexpiry-signature]
